title: The Board's definition of dispensing
rule_summary: Under 247 CMR 2.00, Dispensing means the physical act of delivering a drug, chemical, device or combination thereof to an ultimate user pursuant to the lawful order of a practitioner, as defined in M.G.L. c. 94C, s. 1, including the utilization of the professional judgment of the pharmacist and the packaging, labeling, or compounding necessary to prepare the drug, chemical, or device for delivery.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate can tell when a Board duty written for a pharmacy that dispenses is engaged: the definition turns on delivery to an ultimate user pursuant to the lawful order of a practitioner, and includes the pharmacist's professional judgment and the packaging, labeling or compounding needed to prepare the delivery.

authority.name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy regulations

common_confusions: Treating every sale of a drug by a pharmacy as dispensing, when the definition turns on delivery to an ultimate user pursuant to the lawful order of a practitioner.
verification_notes: Read on 2026-09-16 in the Board of Registration in Pharmacy's publication of 247 CMR 2.00 on mass.gov (PDF).
